method.start: Trusted click event.timeStamp. First actionable navigation link is observed in-page from document initialization.
method.completion: Exact canonical AND displayed OHLC, source, symbol, interval and real series identity match on two consecutive rendering frames. Visible completion additionally requires 100x100 viewport intersection and five unobscured plot hit-test points.
method.click: After document commit, immediately issue the visible Scanner-link click. No metadata fetch, screenshot, readback or intentional hover dwell precedes it.
method.cache: Full-document route reloads with intercepted requests (HTTP cache disabled by Playwright routing). Initial fixture preparation primes browser resources; this is not cold browser-process startup.
method.failures: Every planned attempt remains. A blocked or late click, missing response, incorrect series or offscreen chart cannot pass. Successful timing distributions are labelled separately.
